test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_bf_cast (j JSON) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity_bytes = 0
ALTER TABLE json_bf_cast ADD INDEX bf j TYPE jsonbf_v1() GRANULARITY 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_bf_cast SELECT * FROM format(RowBinary, 'j JSON', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(n -> concat(unhex('030166'), formatRowNoNewline('RowBinary', CAST(toFloat32(n + 0.5) AS Dynamic)), unhex('0169'), formatRowNoNewline('RowBinary', CAST(toInt32(n) AS Dynamic)), unhex('0175'), formatRowNoNewline('RowBinary', CAST(toUInt32(n) AS Dynamic))), range(1000000)))) SETTINGS input_format_binary_read_json_as_string = 0
